osworld2.notesShort: Author-run on the official OSWorld 2.0 harness (108 long-horizon tasks); max thinking with batched tool calls, 500-step budget. 54.8% partial score. Best tracked binary completion.
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget. 49.3% partial score. Batched tool calls lift the same model to 20.6% (see row above).
Author-run; max thinking with batched tool calls, 500-step budget. 48.9% partial score.
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$3,870 per run). 49.1% partial score.
Author-run; xhigh reasoning with batched tool calls, 500-step budget (~$2,750 per run). Plateaus at 13.0% across 150/300/500 steps; 49.5% partial score.
Author-run; medium thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$1,550 per run). 33.9% partial score.
Author-run; max thinking, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$2,410 per run). Lower binary score than medium but higher partial (41.5%).
Author-run; reasoning enabled, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$259 per run). 22.3% partial score.
Author-run; reasoning enabled, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$708 per run). 22.1% partial score.
Author-run; thinking mode, standard tool calls, 500-step budget (~$412 per run). 21.5% partial score.
